# Phase 1.1 - customer-leakage check (generated by scripts/v2_leakage_check.py)

Environment: Python 3.12.3, scikit-learn 1.8.0, xgboost 3.4.1.

## Data structure

- Rows: 1556 (374 fraud). Customers: 481.
- Customers appearing as BOTH legit and fraud: 0.
- Share of test rows whose customer is also in training: v1 folds 0.88, grouped folds 0.00.

## Results (mean +/- std over 5 fold seeds, threshold 0.5)

| split | features | precision | recall | F1 | PR-AUC | FP | FN |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| v1_trace_hash | all_28_features | 0.984+/-0.003 | 0.977+/-0.003 | 0.980+/-0.002 | 0.997 | 6.0 | 8.6 |
| v1_trace_hash | no_HESITATION_DELTA | 0.984+/-0.004 | 0.976+/-0.003 | 0.980+/-0.002 | 0.996 | 6.0 | 8.8 |
| v1_trace_hash | v1_ablation_no_shortcut_benef_device | 0.979+/-0.003 | 0.967+/-0.002 | 0.973+/-0.001 | 0.992 | 7.6 | 12.2 |
| v2_customer_grouped | all_28_features | 0.986+/-0.001 | 0.976+/-0.003 | 0.981+/-0.001 | 0.996 | 5.2 | 8.8 |
| v2_customer_grouped | no_HESITATION_DELTA | 0.985+/-0.001 | 0.976+/-0.004 | 0.981+/-0.002 | 0.996 | 5.4 | 9.0 |
| v2_customer_grouped | v1_ablation_no_shortcut_benef_device | 0.981+/-0.005 | 0.967+/-0.003 | 0.974+/-0.001 | 0.991 | 7.0 | 12.4 |

## How to read this

- If grouped F1 is close to v1 F1, customer overlap is NOT what drives the high scores.
- Compare the gap with the std: a gap smaller than ~2 std is within noise.
- High scores in the ablation row point to the simulator making attacks easy to separate (Phase 1.6 and Phase 2 test this).
